project_role: bounded research-prototype development; not deployment validation
objective: Test whether domain-balanced, attack-family-aware development improves endpoint-free NetFlow intrusion-detection robustness compared with an otherwise matched unweighted Random Forest baseline.
hypothesis: Balancing development contribution by dataset and attack family, combined with stronger Random Forest regularisation, will improve leave-one-dataset-out MCC, worst-domain balanced accuracy, and supported attack-family recall without an unacceptable false-positive-rate increase.

known_at_registration.dominant_audit_finding: FTP-BruteForce and DoS attacks-SlowHTTPTest were absent from sampled validation, formed 81.12% of confirmation attacks, and each had zero recall
known_at_registration.interpretation: These observations motivated the protocol but are not independent evidence for Version 2.

development_domains.name: NF-CSE-CIC-IDS2018
development_domains.role: opened Version 2 development domain; all former partitions, including consumed confirmation, lose holdout status

independent_confirmation_boundary.requirement: A final Version 2 confirmation requires a genuinely new dataset or capture that has not been inspected, scored, audited, or used in this protocol.
independent_confirmation_boundary.registration_rule: Its identity, hashes, model artifact, threshold, metrics, attack-family rule, and decision rule must be committed in a separate protocol before row-level access or scoring.
independent_confirmation_boundary.fallback_if_unavailable: Report Version 2 as a development-only research prototype and do not make deployment or real-world generalisation claims.

features.shortcut_rule: TTL-related fields are prohibited in every Version 2 candidate. They are not consistently available across the four NetFlow domains and were previously identified as potential setup shortcuts.
features.preprocessing_rule: Fit numeric transforms and categorical encoders only on the training portions of the three source domains in each fold. Unknown categories must be ignored at evaluation time.

group_and_sampling_protocol.group_definition: Categorical values exact; numeric values rounded to five significant digits across the eight common endpoint-free features.
group_and_sampling_protocol.group_hash: SHA-256 of the canonical grouped feature tuple, namespaced by dataset.
group_and_sampling_protocol.cross_partition_rule: All rows from one namespaced group remain in one within-domain partition.
group_and_sampling_protocol.cap_method: Deterministic second-hash group sampling within dataset by binary class and raw attack label; retain complete groups and preserve every attack label with available support before filling remaining capacity.
group_and_sampling_protocol.held_out_domain_evaluation: Score the full held-out dataset in chunks; do not subsample evaluation rows.
group_and_sampling_protocol.weighting: For weighted candidates, normalise row weights so each source dataset contributes equally, then so each supported raw attack label contributes equally within that dataset; normal traffic is one additional family. Cap any individual row weight at ten times the median non-zero weight and renormalise.

folds: hold out NF-UNSW-NB15; develop on the other three domains
hold out NF-ToN-IoT; develop on the other three domains
hold out NF-BoT-IoT; develop on the other three domains
hold out NF-CSE-CIC-IDS2018; develop on the other three domains
evaluation_design.held_out_domain_use: The held-out domain in each fold may be scored once per preregistered candidate for development comparison. It must not be used to fit preprocessing, models, weights, or thresholds.
evaluation_design.research_status: Because all four domains were inspected before registration, these are source-aware development folds, not untouched external tests.

threshold_rule.scope: calibration portions of the three source domains only
threshold_rule.selection: Among feasible thresholds, maximise the minimum source-domain MCC; break ties by higher mean source-domain MCC, higher minimum supported-attack recall, lower maximum false-positive rate, then higher threshold.
threshold_rule.no_feasible_threshold: Select the threshold that maximises minimum source-domain MCC using the same tie-break order, mark the candidate constraint_failed, and prevent it from passing the Version 2 promotion gate.

metrics.primary: macro-average held-out-domain MCC across the four folds
metrics.uncertainty: For the matched baseline and any promotion-eligible candidate, compute paired 95% bootstrap intervals over exact evaluation groups within each held-out domain using 200 replicates and seed 42.

eligibility_requirements: threshold constraints passed in all four folds
balanced accuracy is greater than 0.50 in every held-out domain
false-positive rate is at most 0.25 in every held-out domain
recall is at least 0.20 for every held-out raw attack label with at least 100 rows
improvement_requirements: macro-average held-out-domain MCC exceeds the matched baseline by at least 0.05
worst held-out-domain balanced accuracy exceeds the matched baseline by at least 0.02
maximum held-out-domain false-positive rate is no more than 0.02 above the matched baseline
promotion_rule.ranking: Among candidates meeting every eligibility and improvement requirement, select highest macro-average held-out-domain MCC; break ties by higher worst-domain balanced accuracy, higher minimum supported-attack recall, lower maximum false-positive rate, then candidate ID alphabetically.
promotion_rule.failure_outcome: If no candidate satisfies every requirement, record 'no Version 2 candidate selected' and do not weaken the rule after viewing results.
promotion_rule.claim_boundary: Passing this rule means development-promising research prototype only; it does not establish independent generalisation or deployment readiness.

overfitting_checks: training-to-calibration and calibration-to-held-out gaps for MCC, balanced accuracy, recall and false-positive rate
per-domain and per-attack recall rather than aggregate accuracy alone
paired comparison against the matched unweighted baseline on identical held-out groups
performance by repeated-group-size bucket and mixed-label status
comparison of all-feature and reduced-feature weighted Random Forests
Random Forest out-of-bag score where available

allowed: implement and test the registered runner
verify existing dataset and evidence hashes
construct the registered group partitions and deterministic bounded source samples
fit only the four registered candidates
select thresholds only by the registered source-calibration rule
compare candidates only using the registered leave-one-dataset-out development metrics
report a failed promotion rule without changing it
prohibited: describe any of the four opened datasets as untouched confirmation
add candidates, features, thresholds, or alternate splits after viewing Version 2 results
use endpoint identifiers or TTL-related shortcut features
fit preprocessing, weights, models, or thresholds using a fold's held-out domain
select a model using aggregate accuracy alone
make a deployment or real-world readiness claim
reuse any future confirmation dataset for tuning after it is opened
integrity_rules.amendment_rule: A necessary implementation correction must be documented and committed before rerunning any affected experiment. A substantive design change creates a new protocol version rather than silently altering this file.

stopping_rule: Run the registered development experiment once after preflight tests pass. Do not silently retry a failed run. Stop after reporting the fixed promotion verdict; any additional hypothesis requires a new protocol version.
interpretation_boundary: Version 2 is a bounded, post-audit research prototype. Leave-one-dataset-out performance can reject weak designs and provide stronger development evidence, but only a separately preregistered genuinely new dataset or capture can independently confirm generalisation.
